notes: Bootstrapped by scoring each exported SDK type's field-set against each spec schema's property-set, then every entry was verified by reading the source.

Scope decisions (not individually re-justified per entry): (1) path-identifier params bundled into an Input type for URL building (customer_id, id, bank_account_id, memberId, payout_id, and instance_id as a query param on UploadInput) are expected and not tracked as gaps or divergences. (2) discriminator fields injected by a factory function body (type/kyc_type on customers and bank-accounts, is_account_abstraction on blockchain wallets, the role->user_role rename on instance members) are expected to be absent from the corresponding input type. (3) nesting is curated one level deep; deeper nested sub-objects (e.g. VirtualAccountOut.us/blockchain_wallet's own inner fields, PayinTrackingTransaction's pse_instruction/transfers_instruction/ted_instruction sub-fields) are out of scope for this pass.

Reachability: every reachable schema (computed by transitive $ref from paths + the top-level webhooks object) is either referenced by an enums/types entry's spec.schema, or listed in ignore.schemas. Verified programmatically at bootstrap time.
